key_finding: SLC7A11 expression does NOT differ significantly between HER2-enriched and other subtypes (delta=+6.8%, t=0.90, NS). However, within-HER2-enriched CV=59.4% confirms HIGH heterogeneity — the IHC stratification premise of hyp-her2-001 is VIABLE: meaningful high-vs-low SLC7A11 subgroups exist within HER2+ (Q1=104, Q3=276 — 2.7-fold IQR spread). This resolves the evaluator's concern: the biomarker stratification premise is data-supported.

evidential_quality_update.gap_closed: SLC7A11 within-HER2+ heterogeneity confirmed (CV=59.4%, Q1/Q3 span 2.7x)
evidential_quality_update.remaining_gap: DXd-specific mitochondrial ROS mechanism — not directly confirmable via cBioPortal; requires literature
